summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Ascentage Pharma Group International, a foreign private issuer, furnishing its Hong Kong annual report, ESG report, and materials for an upcoming annual general meeting (AGM) including notice, director re-election proposals, share issuance and repurchase mandates, and RSU/option grants. No special situation event is present. The filing does not describe any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or other special situation. It is purely a standard periodic report and AGM circular, which should be categorized as 'None' for special-situation purposes.
